search.external.title: Search engine
search.external.help: For very large wikis the full text search can use OpenSearch/Elasticsearch or Meilisearch (typo tolerance, better relevance). The wiki keeps its own index as the reference: the external index follows every change automatically within seconds and can be rebuilt at any time. While it is being built or if the engine fails, the built-in search answers. Permissions are always checked by the wiki.
search.external.index_help: Default ewiki. Changing it builds a new index.
search.external.api_key_help: Meilisearch: master or admin key. OpenSearch/Elasticsearch: API key (alternatively user name and password).
search.external.building: The {engine} index is being built; until then the built-in search is used.
